summary: Fix the keyboard trap Joel hit after opening recommended products by moving focus to the product page’s Add To Cart button when the product changes, instead of leaving focus down in the recommendations list.

edits.replace: import { useCallback, useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
edits.why: This adds a ref so focus can be moved away from the recommended product card after navigation.
This creates a reference to the Add To Cart button that keyboard users need after opening a product.
This prevents focus from staying in the recommendations section and puts keyboard users on the main purchase control for the new product.
This makes the Add To Cart button receive focus after a product navigation.
